name: BB Mean Reversion on ES Futures
description: Bollinger Band mean reversion strategy on ES (S&P 500 E-Mini futures, continuous contract) using 1-hour bars. Long when close touches/crosses below lower BB(20, 2.0), short when close touches/crosses above upper BB(20, 2.0). Exits when price crosses back through the 20-period middle band. ATR(14)-based position sizing risking 1% equity per trade, with 2x ATR(14) stop loss. Front-month rollover with 5-day pre-expiry offset, backward ratio adjustment.
source:
# ============================================================================
# Bollinger Band Mean Reversion — ES Futures (1H bars)
# Long at lower band touch, short at upper band touch.
# Exit at middle band crossover. ATR-based sizing & stop.
# ============================================================================

# --- Data ---
# Load 1H bars directly via target_timeframe
src = study_assets(target_timeframe=["1H"])()

# Continuous front-month contract: LastTradingDay roll, 5 days before expiry
# BackwardRatio preserves % returns for backtesting
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LastTradingDay,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio,
    i_offset=5
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Indicators ---
# Bollinger Bands: 20-period SMA, 2.0 standard deviations on 1H close
upper, mid, lower = bbands(cont.c, period=20, stddev=2.0)

# ATR(14) on 1H bars for position sizing and stop distance
atr_val = atr(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, 14)

# --- Entry Signals ---
# Long: price touches or crosses below lower band (persistent while below)
long_touch = cont.c <= lower

# Short: price touches or crosses above upper band (persistent while above)
short_touch = cont.c >= upper

# --- Exit Signals ---
# Long exit: price crosses back above the middle band
long_exit = crossover(cont.c, mid)

# Short exit: price crosses back below the middle band
short_exit = crossunder(cont.c, mid)

# --- State Management ---
# hold_until: enter on band touch, hold until mid-band cross exit
long_held = hold_until(long_touch, long_exit)
short_held = hold_until(short_touch, short_exit)

# --- Execution (strict wiring order: rollover → zone → sizing → exits) ---

# 1. Rollover policy — required for futures
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# 2. Entry/exit signal executor
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_held, short_entry=short_held)

# 3. ATR-based position sizing: risk 1% equity, stop at 2x ATR
#    risk_unit bundles the stop loss — no separate stop_loss needed
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(risk_pct=1, stop_distance=atr_val * 2)
